mapper.insert: INSERT INTO script_marketing_definition (tenant_id, created_by, name, steps_json, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{createdBy}, #{name}, #{stepsJson}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM script_marketing_definition WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM script_marketing_definition WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE script_marketing_definition SET name=#{name}, steps_json=#{stepsJson}, enabled=#{enabled}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE script_marketing_definition SET deleted_at=#{now}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, enabled, updated_at FROM script_marketing_definition WHERE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
